question: A sum of ₹x amounts to ₹83,853 in 2(1)/(2) years at 12% p.a., interest compounded 10-monthly. What is the value of x?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount (A) = ₹83,853

Time (t) = 2 years = 30 months

Rate (r) = 12% p.a., compounding every 10 months

Principal (P) = ₹x

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + rₚ/100)ⁿ

Where:

rₚ = rate per period = (12 × 10/12)% = 10%

n = number of periods = 30 ÷ 10 = 3

**Calculations:**

83,853 = x(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ 83,853 = x(1.1)³

⇒ 83,853 = x × 1.331

⇒ x = 83,853 ÷ 1.331

⇒ x = 63,000

**∴ The principal is ₹63,000.**
